scope: Read-only readiness audit of exact-agent delineate replay coverage, observable behavior-cloning labels, prior imitation overlap, and the minimum closed-loop successor gate.

current_battle_window.note: The battle window is right-censored and is not the cumulative corpus.

observable: player-relative public map and complete pre-action state
final ordered command sequence for every turn
primitive verb, unit id, target coordinate, and resource kind
actual TRAIN timing and four-stat specification
past emitted actions, if a successor deliberately includes history
latent: train-plan target selected on turns before an actual TRAIN
previous internal train target used by the public plan head
joint-action beam alternatives, invalidations, and probabilities
PPO rewards, advantages, value targets, weights, and curriculum states
identifiability.boundary: The corpus exactly identifies final primitive/joint outputs on teacher states. It does not identify delineate's hidden planner or action distribution, and teacher-state labels alone do not identify closed-loop value.

public_architecture.network: four-block ResNet with spatial action head and shared 144-candidate train-plan head
public_architecture.inference: one plan inference plus one inference per troll, followed by a joint-action beam

prior_work.representation: 13 coarse state features with nested lookup backoff
prior_work.result: delineate 60.413% accuracy / 0.329 macro F1; failed macro-F1 gate
prior_work.relation: negative prior, not duplicate: L1 has 7.65x games, exact primitive targets, and a spatial/full-state representation

prior_work.target: objective, target, and rendered command continuation
prior_work.relation: closed-loop warning from a different teacher

prior_work.target: intent plus goal rankers and workforce ladder
prior_work.validation: held game then complete native controller
prior_work.result: 76.937% held-game intent accuracy but -172.663 paired margin closed-loop
prior_work.relation: direct warning that teacher-state accuracy is not a value gate; different teacher and labels

prior_work.target: candidate index under exact conditional lexicographic ordering
prior_work.relation: function-class warning, not duplicate: teacher, action surface, and representation differ

prior_work.result: rank one; about 101k policy parameters, 98k-character submission, 2-3 ms
prior_work.relation: demonstrates feasibility of the architecture class but publishes neither weights nor hidden labels

successor.first_phase: Compose-only exact-agent state/final-command extractor and parity report on the 199 consumed games.
successor.target: Final per-unit primitive command plus actual TRAIN event/spec; no inferred train-plan, logits, beam alternatives, or task grammar.
partitions: retain an ordered temporal block because newest games are opponent-concentrated
report held-opponent sensitivity separately from held-game metrics
successor.mandatory_value_gate: No trained clone advances from teacher-forced metrics. A separately frozen closed-loop official-map panel must beat the exact resident on score and margin, transfer by opponent family, satisfy runtime/source-size gates, and either preserve the resident fallback or first establish same-panel dominance.
not_authorized: candidate, source integration, submission, or Arena action
